ezil_lifecycle_intents_scope_chk.name: ezil_lifecycle_intents_scope_chk
ezil_lifecycle_intents_scope_chk.value:
(provider_instance_id IS NULL OR provider_instance_id ~ '^i-[a-f0-9]{17}$')
        AND (data_volume_id IS NULL OR data_volume_id ~ '^vol-[a-f0-9]{17}$')
        AND (previous_instance_id IS NULL OR previous_instance_id ~ '^i-[a-f0-9]{17}$')

ezil_lifecycle_intents_shape_chk.name: ezil_lifecycle_intents_shape_chk
ezil_lifecycle_intents_shape_chk.value:
(operation = 'provision' AND provider_instance_id IS NULL AND data_volume_id IS NULL
            AND previous_generation IS NULL AND previous_instance_id IS NULL AND previous_fence_token IS NULL)
        OR (operation IN ('start','stop','retire') AND provider_instance_id IS NOT NULL AND data_volume_id IS NOT NULL
            AND previous_generation IS NULL AND previous_instance_id IS NULL AND previous_fence_token IS NULL)
        OR (operation = 'replace' AND provider_instance_id IS NULL AND data_volume_id IS NOT NULL
            AND previous_generation IS NOT NULL AND previous_generation >= 1 AND previous_generation < target_generation
            AND previous_instance_id IS NOT NULL AND previous_fence_token IS NOT NULL)

ezil_recovery_intents_generation_chk.name: ezil_recovery_intents_generation_chk
ezil_recovery_intents_generation_chk.value: revision >= 1 AND data_generation >= 1 AND target_generation > data_generation

ezil_recovery_intents_source_chk.name: ezil_recovery_intents_source_chk
ezil_recovery_intents_source_chk.value: source_schema_version IN (1,2) AND source_job_id <> job_id AND fence_token <> data_fence_token

ezil_cancellations_reason_chk.name: ezil_cancellations_reason_chk
ezil_cancellations_reason_chk.value: (reason='stop_requested' AND requested_by IS NOT NULL) OR (reason='authority_revoked' AND requested_by IS NULL)

ezil_mount_authority_lifetime_chk.name: ezil_mount_authority_lifetime_chk
ezil_mount_authority_lifetime_chk.value: expires_at = issued_at + interval '900 seconds' AND provider_observed_at BETWEEN issued_at - interval '30 seconds' AND issued_at + interval '5 seconds'

ezil_mount_delivery_receipt_chk.name: ezil_mount_delivery_receipt_chk
ezil_mount_delivery_receipt_chk.value: (mounted_at IS NULL) = (receipt IS NULL) AND (receipt IS NULL OR octet_length(receipt) BETWEEN 2 AND 4096)

ezil_control_binding_creation_chk.name: ezil_control_binding_creation_chk
ezil_control_binding_creation_chk.value:
(key_confirmed_at IS NULL) = (secret_arn IS NULL)
        AND (key_confirmed_at IS NULL OR (create_attempted_at IS NOT NULL AND key_confirmed_at >= create_attempted_at))
        AND (secret_arn IS NULL OR secret_arn ~ ('^arn:aws:secretsmanager:' || region || ':' || account_id || ':secret:'
            || namespace || '/computers/' || computer_id::text || '/generations/' || computer_generation::text || '/control-[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$'))

ezil_control_binding_reference_chk.name: ezil_control_binding_reference_chk
ezil_control_binding_reference_chk.value:
region = 'us-east-1' AND account_id ~ '^[0-9]{12}$'
        AND namespace ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,30}$' AND octet_length(control_domain) <= 190
        AND control_domain ~ '^([a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?[.])+[a-z]{2,63}$'
        AND kms_key_arn ~ ('^arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:' || account_id || ':key/[a-f0-9-]{36}$')

ezil_start_authority_lifetime_chk.name: ezil_start_authority_lifetime_chk
ezil_start_authority_lifetime_chk.value: expires_at = issued_at + interval '300 seconds' AND provider_observed_at BETWEEN issued_at - interval '30 seconds' AND issued_at + interval '5 seconds'

ezil_start_delivery_receipt_chk.name: ezil_start_delivery_receipt_chk
ezil_start_delivery_receipt_chk.value: (started_at IS NULL) = (receipt IS NULL) AND (receipt IS NULL OR octet_length(receipt) BETWEEN 2 AND 4096)

ezil_app_audit_scope_chk.name: ezil_app_audit_scope_chk
ezil_app_audit_scope_chk.value: (release_id is null or app_id is not null) and (installation_id is null or computer_id is not null)

ezil_app_folder_grants_scope_chk.name: ezil_app_folder_grants_scope_chk
ezil_app_folder_grants_scope_chk.value: (scope = 'whole-folder' and project_id is null) or (scope = 'selected-projects' and folder = 'Projects' and project_id is not null)

ezil_app_jobs_target_chk.name: ezil_app_jobs_target_chk
ezil_app_jobs_target_chk.value: ((operation in ('inspect','build') and submission_id is not null and installation_id is null and computer_id is null) or (operation in ('install','start','stop','update','uninstall') and submission_id is null and installation_id is not null and computer_id is not null))

ezil_app_releases_digest_chk.name: ezil_app_releases_digest_chk
ezil_app_releases_digest_chk.value: manifest_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND policy_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND provenance_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND image_reference ~ '@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'

ezil_app_releases_source_pin_chk.name: ezil_app_releases_source_pin_chk
ezil_app_releases_source_pin_chk.value: ((coalesce(manifest #>> '{source,kind}','') = 'github') and source_commit_sha is not null and source_commit_sha ~ '^[0-9a-f]{40}$' and source_commit_sha = lower(coalesce(manifest #>> '{source,commitSha}',''))) or ((coalesce(manifest #>> '{source,kind}','') = 'oci') and source_commit_sha is null and image_reference = coalesce(manifest #>> '{source,image}',''))

ezil_app_releases_approval_chk.name: ezil_app_releases_approval_chk
ezil_app_releases_approval_chk.value: (status in ('draft','validated','rejected') and approved_by is null and approved_at is null and revoked_at is null) or (status = 'approved' and approved_by is not null and approved_at is not null and revoked_at is null) or (status = 'revoked' and approved_by is not null and approved_at is not null and revoked_at is not null)

ezil_app_services_ports_chk.name: ezil_app_services_ports_chk
ezil_app_services_ports_chk.value: internal_port between 1024 and 65535 AND (preferred_host_port is null or preferred_host_port between 1024 and 65535)

ezil_app_submissions_pin_chk.name: ezil_app_submissions_pin_chk
ezil_app_submissions_pin_chk.value: (requested_commit_sha is null or requested_commit_sha ~ '^[0-9a-f]{40}$') AND (resolved_commit_sha is null or resolved_commit_sha ~ '^[0-9a-f]{40}$')

ezil_app_runtime_commands_plan_chk.name: ezil_app_runtime_commands_plan_chk
ezil_app_runtime_commands_plan_chk.value: jsonb_typeof(plan) = 'object' AND octet_length(plan::text) <= 49152 AND coalesce(plan->>'releaseId','') = release_id::text AND coalesce(plan->>'policyDigest','') ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'

ezil_computer_configuration_deliveries_d.name: ezil_computer_configuration_deliveries_due_idx
ezil_computer_configuration_deliveries_d.where: loaded_at IS NULL AND superseded_at IS NULL

ezil_computer_configuration_deliveries_r.name: ezil_computer_configuration_deliveries_receipt_chk
ezil_computer_configuration_deliveries_r.value:
(loaded_at IS NULL) = (loaded_digest IS NULL)
        AND (loaded_at IS NULL OR (prepared_at IS NOT NULL AND loaded_at >= prepared_at AND superseded_at IS NULL))

ezil_computer_configurations_envelope_ch.name: ezil_computer_configurations_envelope_chk
ezil_computer_configurations_envelope_ch.value:
COALESCE((
        jsonb_typeof(configuration::jsonb) = 'object'
        AND configuration::jsonb ?& ARRAY['schemaVersion','computerId','computerGeneration','configurationRevision','volumeId',
            'dataRoot','stateDirectory','stagingRoot','controlPort','memoryBudgetMiB','suspended','preparedInstallations','approvedInstallations']
        AND configuration::jsonb - ARRAY['schemaVersion','computerId','computerGeneration','configurationRevision','volumeId',
            'dataRoot','stateDirectory','stagingRoot','controlPort','memoryBudgetMiB','suspended','preparedInstallations','approvedInstallations'] = '{}'::jsonb
        AND configuration::jsonb->'schemaVersion' = '1'::jsonb
        AND configuration::jsonb->>'computerId' = computer_id::text
        AND configuration::jsonb->'computerGeneration' = to_jsonb(computer_generation)
        AND configuration::jsonb->'configurationRevision' = to_jsonb(revision)
        AND configuration::jsonb->>'volumeId' = data_volume_id
        AND jsonb_typeof(configuration::jsonb->'suspended') = 'boolean'
        AND jsonb_typeof(configuration::jsonb->'preparedInstallations') = 'array'
        AND jsonb_typeof(configuration::jsonb->'approvedInstallations') = 'array'
        AND jsonb_array_length(configuration::jsonb->'preparedInstallations') <= 128
        AND jsonb_array_length(configuration::jsonb->'approvedInstallations') <= 128
    ), false)
